title: IKMo: Image-Keyframed Motion Generation with Trajectory-Pose Conditioned Motion Diffusion Model
description:
arXiv:2505.21146v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: While text-to-motion generation is mainstream, integrating explicit spatial constraints has become a standard solution for precise animation. Existing state-of-the-art models are tailored for professional workflows, effectively processing high-quality, pre-aligned 3D inputs via unified conditioning mechanisms. However, this strictly aligned setting restricts accessibility for general users who rely on unaligned, in-the-wild 2D reference images. This accessible scenario introduces a fundamental conflict: heterogeneous geometric constraints, where user-defined global trajectories clash with local image-derived poses. To resolve this coordinate mismatch, we propose TPMDM, a diffusion model featuring a decoupled parallel control strategy that explicitly isolates and aligns these divergent signals. Furthermore, we introduce IKMo, a holistic framework that synergizes TPMDM with a VLM-powered multi-agent system. By bridging the semantic-geometric gap, IKMo translates user-friendly inputs into explicit motion constraints to drive the diffusion backbone. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate that our method establishes a new state-of-the-art in the task of generating motions under heterogeneous trajectory and keyframe pose constraints.
